circle_yml.string:
version: 2
jobs:
  build_test:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install package from wheel
        command: pip install dist/*.whl
    - run:
        name: Install test dependencies
        command: pip install pytest pyyaml
    - run:
        name: Run tests against the installed wheel
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
        command: pytest --import-mode=append -m "not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
    - run:
        name: Run source-tree tests against the checkout
        command: python -m pytest -m source_tree --junitxml=test-reports/results-source-tree.xml
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
  app_test_floor:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    resource_class: medium
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install wheel and app test dependencies (floor)
        command: |
          if [ "floor" = "floor" ]; then
            STREAMLIT="streamlit==1.56.0"
          else
            STREAMLIT="streamlit"
          fi
          pip install dist/*.whl "$STREAMLIT" plotly pyyaml pytest
          mkdir -p artifacts
          pip freeze > artifacts/pip-freeze-floor.txt
          cat artifacts/pip-freeze-floor.txt
    - run:
        name: Run tests against the installed wheel, with the app
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_APP_DEPS: '1'
        command: pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
    - run:
        name: Check that only the allowed tests skipped
        command: python .circleci/check_app_skips.py test-reports/results.xml
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
    - store_artifacts:
        path: artifacts
        when: always
  app_control_python_m:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    resource_class: medium
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install (python_m)
        command: |
          if [ "python_m" = "noplotly" ]; then
            pip install dist/*.whl streamlit pyyaml pytest
          else
            pip install dist/*.whl "streamlit==1.56.0" plotly pyyaml pytest
          fi
          pip freeze
    - run:
        name: Run tests (python_m)
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_APP_DEPS: '1'
        command: |
          if [ "python_m" = "noplotly" ]; then
            pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
          else
            python -m pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
          fi
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
  app_control_noplotly:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    resource_class: medium
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install (noplotly)
        command: |
          if [ "noplotly" = "noplotly" ]; then
            pip install dist/*.whl streamlit pyyaml pytest
          else
            pip install dist/*.whl "streamlit==1.56.0" plotly pyyaml pytest
          fi
          pip freeze
    - run:
        name: Run tests (noplotly)
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_APP_DEPS: '1'
        command: |
          if [ "noplotly" = "noplotly" ]; then
            pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
          else
            python -m pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
          fi
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
  app_test_newest:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    resource_class: medium
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install wheel and app test dependencies (newest)
        command: |
          if [ "newest" = "floor" ]; then
            STREAMLIT="streamlit==1.56.0"
          else
            STREAMLIT="streamlit"
          fi
          pip install dist/*.whl "$STREAMLIT" plotly pyyaml pytest
          mkdir -p artifacts
          pip freeze > artifacts/pip-freeze-newest.txt
          cat artifacts/pip-freeze-newest.txt
    - run:
        name: Run tests against the installed wheel, with the app
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_APP_DEPS: '1'
        command: pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
    - run:
        name: Check that only the allowed tests skipped
        command: python .circleci/check_app_skips.py test-reports/results.xml
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
    - store_artifacts:
        path: artifacts
        when: always
workflows:
  build_test_publish:
    jobs:
    - build_test
    - app_test_floor: {}
    - app_test_newest: {}
    - app_control_noplotly: {}
    - app_control_python_m: {}
  version: 2

pip freeze
